record.title: Unauthenticated /health discloses catalog upload root and disk inventory
record.description: GET /health has no Depends authentication and returns HealthResponse with catalog_upload_root=str(upload_root()), catalog_image_files_on_disk from a bounded rglob, catalog_r2_configured, Gemini model names, and appraiser flags.
record.claimed_root_cause: health() is unauthenticated and serializes upload_root() and _count_catalog_image_files() into HealthResponse, unlike production path redaction used for job input_folder.

trace.description: Anonymous health route with no Depends authentication.
upload_root() resolves backend/data/uploads to an absolute Path.
Handler returns catalog_upload_root=str(root), image file count, r2 flag, and model names to the anonymous client.

evidence.description: catalog_upload_root is the raw absolute path string, not public_job_input_folder.
catalog_image_files_on_disk calls _count_catalog_image_files() on every anonymous request.
HealthResponse includes catalog_upload_root, catalog_image_files_on_disk, and catalog_r2_configured.
public_job_input_folder redacts absolute paths in production for JobOut.input_folder only; health does not call it.
Operators are told that public GET /health reports catalog_r2_configured when R2 vars are set.

record.reason: Source confirms the unauthenticated serializer: backend/app/main.py:851 health() has no identity Depends; :854-862 returns catalog_upload_root=str(upload_root()), catalog_image_files_on_disk from _count_catalog_image_files() (:836 rglob, cap 200000), catalog_r2_configured, and settings model names. HealthResponse at backend/app/schemas.py:11-19 includes those fields. SecurityHeadersMiddleware, CORS, and optional TrustedHost do not authenticate the route. That is not a meaningful cross-boundary result. upload_root() at backend/app/catalog_storage.py:20-22 is the fixed resolve of backend/data/uploads beside this file. infra/docker/Dockerfile.api:14-16 copies backend under /app and creates backend/data/uploads, so the absolute string is the documented layout. DEPLOY.md:112 already names that cache path; :64 publishes GET /health on the API domain as the liveness probe; :118 documents that the same probe reports catalog_r2_configured. Gemini model defaults are in backend/app/config.py:105-106. The integer file count names no account, file, or tenant object, and the route does not read or serve catalog bytes. public_job_input_folder (backend/app/config.py:247, used only from _job_out at backend/app/main.py:536) redacts per-job input_folder strings for authenticated clients in production; it is not a control on this fixed application directory. Chatty public health JSON is missing probe hygiene, not disclosure of a protected resource. A TestClient GET is not a decisive missing fact: FastAPI serializes the HealthResponse the handler constructs.
